$comment: PDF export (feature 014): the File > Export entry, the Save dialog's page sizes, the export's progress, messages and reasons. Feature catalogue merged by i18n/index.ts.

exportPdf.description: Write the book as a searchable PDF/A file in a page size you choose, with bookmarks, links, footnotes and the whole description in its metadata

pdf.exportDone: Exported to {{path}}: {{pages}} pages in {{size}}, {{pictures}} pictures, {{tables}} tables, {{notes}} notes.
pdf.exportCancelled: The export was cancelled; no file was written.
pdf.exportSummaryIntro: Not everything was carried over as written:

summary.pictureLeftOut: Picture {{detail}} left out: it has no data, or it is not a picture
summary.fontReplaced: Font “{{detail}}” replaced by the editor's own font of its kind
summary.systemFont: Drawn with a system font, as no font the editor ships has them: {{detail}}
summary.linkAsText: Link to {{detail}} written as text: nothing in the book has that id
summary.idTwice: The id {{detail}} is used more than once: only its first place keeps it
summary.noTitle: The book has no title: the file’s name “{{detail}}” is its title in the PDF
summary.noLanguage: The book’s language is not given: the words the export adds are in English
summary.addedFontFallback: Not in {{font}}, drawn with the shipped fonts: {{detail}}
summary.rawPart: Not printed - kept as XML that is not valid FB2 there, which Preview does not show: {{detail}}

reason.printFailed: the browser engine could not print the pages ({{message}})
reason.targetIsSource: the file chosen is the book itself, or the archive it was opened from
reason.badPageSize: the page size is not one of the nine
reason.ioError: the file could not be written ({{message}})
reason.checkFailed: the finished file failed its own check ({{message}})
reason.unknownToken: the export was no longer known to the core
reason.noPart: a part of the pages is missing
reason.tooManyPages: the book has more pages than a PDF the editor writes may have

limit.pages: the book would take {{count}} pages; a PDF the editor writes has at most {{max}}
limit.notes: the book has {{count}} notes; a PDF the editor writes holds at most {{max}}

settings.chooseFace: Choose a face of the collection

refused.unreadable: The file is not a font the editor can read.
refused.restricted: The font’s licence forbids embedding it in a document.
refused.bitmapOnly: The font allows only its bitmaps to be embedded, and it has none.
refused.tooLarge: The font file is larger than 64 MB.
refused.duplicate: The font has been added already.
refused.noInstalledFonts: The fonts installed on this computer cannot be listed here.

settings.chooseInstalled: Choose a font installed on this computer

tabs.exports: The settings of each export format: PDF, EPUB, Markdown

pdf.pageSize: The size the Save dialog proposes for a book exported for the first time
pdf.textFont: The font the book’s text is printed in, unless the book names its own
pdf.textSize: The size of the book’s text in the PDF
pdf.margins: The margins of the PDF’s pages
pdf.addFile: Adds a TrueType or OpenType font file; it is kept with the editor’s data
pdf.addInstalled: Adds a font installed on this computer
pdf.remove: Removes the added font chosen as the text font
pdf.face: The face of the font collection to add
pdf.resetAll: Puts every value of this page back to its default
pdf.textSizeValue: The text size this choice gives the default page size above; with Custom, type your own (6 to 24 pt)
pdf.marginValue: The margins this choice gives the default page size above; with Custom, type your own (5 to 50 mm)

exports.format: The export format whose settings are shown below

pdf.pageSize: The page size of this PDF: the ISO sizes first, then the North American ones

settings.none: This format has no settings of its own yet.
